# Solovey UI v2026.3.2-beta.1

This is the truthful prerelease rebuild of the previously published v2026.3.2.
Product-code lineage is eabfe4793c25daf46fbff61f6cd98059d286af68. Only version,
package/release metadata, release policy and their qualification change.
The native ownership and transaction remediation being developed for beta.2
is deliberately absent. The known Debian 13 recovery failure remains applicable.
This candidate is historical qualification evidence, not a recovery recommendation.

Stable remains v2026.3.1. Final v2026.3.2 is reserved for accepted platform support.
BUILD_INFO, signed beta manifest, runtime version, OCI payload and APK metadata
are rebuilt coherently. APK spells the same candidate 2026.3.2_beta1-r25.
The version-independent FriendlyWrt descriptor is unchanged.

The original v2026.3.2 tag object, release/asset inventory, signed envelope and
registry identity are preserved in .github/release-history/v2026.3.2/.
No v2026.3.1 source or release assets are rewritten.
